answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale. Consider a meadow as the anchor of the cost.
